name: task_spawn
description: Spawn one or more independent subagent tasks (1-8) asynchronously in one deterministic batch. Every item is preflight-validated before any child starts; spawn attempts run in input order and returned task entries preserve that order. Each spawned subagent is hard-terminated after 60 minutes of wall-clock lifetime (32 iterations by default), so a long-running subtask ends with a timeout result instead of a late answer. Collect with `task_wait` or `task_status`, then acknowledge with `task_integrate`. For one result needed immediately, use the synchronous `task` tool. Top-level agents only.
first_use_guidance:
Guidance for later task_spawn calls in this turn:
- A per-item runtime spawn failure is reported as status 'failed' with no task_id and does not fail the whole call, so only wait on the task_ids that were returned.

description.description: Short description of what this task will do (3-10 words).

prompt.description: Self-contained instructions: goal, scope, relevant context, constraints, and expected output.

agent.description: Optional subagent name (default: auto-select). Omit unless you know the exact name.

model.description: Optional model override. Default: reuse parent model; override only when the subtask is clearly lighter or heavier.

inherit.description: Default 'cwd,skills' (history/memory private; right for workspace-touching steps). Otherwise 'all', 'none', or a comma-separated subset of 'history','memory','cwd','skills' (e.g. "cwd,skills"). 'none' for pure analysis; 'all' only when the subtask needs the full conversation.

response_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object the subagent's single returned value must match, e.g. {"type": "string"} — not a bare type name. Evidence-gated audit agents reject `response_schema`; call them without one and read the `<audit_report>` envelope from the result.
